nx9a1jqg.sourceDescription: This 60cm mini Christmas tree features realistic 100% PE branches with soft-touch foliage and a distinctive gradient colour design for a natural, full appearance. Its overlapping branches create a bushy look, making it an attractive addition to festive displays. The sturdy weighted cement base helps keep the tree upright and is finished with a choice of decorative red fabric or hessian wrapping. Compact and versatile, this artificial tree is ideal for decorating tables, mantelpieces, windowsills, worktops, offices and apartments, bringing festive charm to smaller spaces. Specifications: Made from 100% PE material with realistic soft-touch foliage and gradient-coloured branches. Features a weighted cement base with red fabric or hessian wrapping. Suitable for indoor use as a tabletop Christmas decoration. Dimensions: Height 60cm; base diameter 12cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

vv9qzyc0.variantName: HOMCOM 6ft Unlit Artificial Christmas Tree with Solid Stand- White
vv9qzyc0.sourceDescription: Bring nature home without mess with this artificial Xmas tree from HOMCOM! Our beautiful holiday tree provides a great alternative to conventional trees. Easy set up with little mess or maintenance required. Designed with a perfect cone shape, the tree narrows on its way up to a nice point on the top on which you can attach the perfect tree topper and its branches provides plenty of room to showcase your favourite ornaments. Sure to become a striking centerpiece for your holiday decor. • Flame-retardant plastic leaves to give a full and lush look to the tree • Noble leaf tips offer lots of room for decorative ornaments • Safe stability with sturdy plastic base • Quick to set up, just push pieces together and fold out the branches • This artificial tree is almost indistinguishable from a real spruce tree • Perfect for indoor decoration at Christmas, foil the festival atmosphere • Colour: White • Material: Plastic • Overall Dimension: Φ55 x 180Hcm • Branch Tip: 390 • Item Label: 830-182WT • Note: To get a full and bushy appearance, please remove and spread out all individual tips to get the best possible look from the tree Warning: for decoration only. Keep away from open flames, heaters and other heat sources. Ensure the product is stable before use. Keep small parts and packaging away from children. Stop using if damaged. 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park Northampton Cross Road Northampton NN4 9FH

v835jgh1.variantName: Artemis Home 6ft Silvenholt Pre-Lit PE/PVC Artificial Christmas Tree
v835jgh1.sourceDescription: Create a welcoming festive centrepiece with the Silvenholt pre-lit artificial Lush Pine, featuring a full pine-style shape and a blend of PE and PVC foliage. Choose the 6ft tree with 1,642 branch tips and 600 LEDs, or the 7ft version with 2,620 tips and 700 LEDs. The foot pedal lets you switch between warm white and multicolour lighting, with steady, twinkling and flashing effects, or alternate between both colours to change the mood of your display. Each size comes with a metal stand and plastic storage bag for packing away once the festivities are over. Adult assembly required. For indoor use only. Artemis Home Ltd. 335A Torquay Road, Paignton, TQ3 2EP

chbvha01.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 120 cm Wide - Green - 240 cm
chbvha01.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 120 cm Wide - Green - 240 cm
chbvha01.sourceDescription: This cone-shaped PVC Artificial Christmas Tree brings modern elegance to your seasonal decor with its sleek and simple design. It enhances any living space or garden, creating a festive presence with minimal ornamentation and maximum impact. Its visually appealing structure can serve as a centerpiece for gatherings, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere while maintaining a stylish appearance that aligns with contemporary aesthetics. Quality PVC Build The tree is constructed from high-quality PVC, known for its durability and weather resistance, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The material ensures longevity while mimicking the lush, evergreen foliage of a real tree, lending a natural look to your decor. Versatile LED Lighting Equipped with flexible LED strip lights, this tree offers warm white illumination that can be adapted to various settings. The USB connection allows for convenient powering options, enabling usage in multiple environments without the need for traditional power adapters. Modern Design With clean lines and a minimalist form, it fits seamlessly into modern decor styles. The understated elegance enhances any space, allowing you to decorate creatively with ornaments or lights for a personalized touch. Easy Installation Requires simple assembly with a screwdriver, accommodating those with minimal DIY experience. The straightforward setup ensures that your holiday preparation is stress-free so you can focus on the festive activities. Indoor &Outdoor Use Suitable for living rooms, gardens, and terraces, this tree adds charm both inside and outside. Its weather-resistant build makes it a flexible addition to your holiday decorations, approachable for various settings and scenarios. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC Tree height: 240 cm Bottom diameter: 120 cm Stand size: 50 x 50 cm Hinged construction for set up lightweight and break-resistant Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 1000 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

Durable Materials: Crafted from premium PVC, this tree presents a lifelike appearance while ensuring durability and long-lasting use. The metal framework provides stability, supporting the tree's structure perfectly and maintaining its shape through multiple festive seasons. This combination of materials makes it both robust and visually appealing. The easy plug-and-play setup enhances usability, allowing for effortless installation and repositioning within any space throughout the holiday season. Warm White LED Lights: A timeless choice for Christmas decorations, the LED strip lights emit a soft, warm glow to create an inviting atmosphere. These energy-efficient lights are not only visually stunning but also ensure consistent illumination without overheating, making them safe for daily use and family-friendly gatherings. Indoor and Outdoor Placement: This artificial tree is suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings, offering versatility in decoration locations. Its adaptable design allows it to grace living rooms, terraces, and gardens, providing festive charm in various environments with minimal maintenance. Care &Storage Tips: For optimal maintenance, cover the tree when not in use and store it in a dry, cool place after the holiday. Regular care ensures its vibrant appearance and functionality over years, allowing you to enjoy festive moments time and again without the hassle of annual tree purchases.
